question: Open question on the bound baseline-replay inventory (execution cf997605885642759ee33920e2c9e2ef, candidate baseline-replay, controller 8f837eb4…, 35 retained controller updates): terminal reach, sampled holding position, sampled holding speed and computation are reported together but disagree, and I want the relationship described rather than a cause asserted. (3) Can the retained evidence support any statement linking the holding-window position/speed excursions to the computation record, or does it only support temporal co-occurrence? Report each answer as retrieved, not displayed, not retained, or not computable, and note that retained limitations state no historical optimizer iterations or full warm plans are reconstructed [f1f3274ca3bd7] and that a single execution does not establish a dominant cause [f15daf227e33d]; also note that a bounded projected-model probe (effective horizon <=0.01 s) is known to be insufficient to explain an entire settling failure and is not the basis of this question.

stopping_conditions: Stop when terminal reach, sampled holding-window position, sampled holding-window speed and computation have each been stated as separate fact-handled observations with their coverage (6 rows of the final 0.05 s window; 35 retained updates; terminal endpoint update 34 / t=0.35 s), or explicitly marked not displayed, not read in this context, not retained, or not computable.

Stop when it has been stated whether the terminal reach pass is confined to a single sampled endpoint and whether holding-window position/speed excursions can be related to the computation record beyond temporal co-occurrence, without asserting a dominant cause.

Stop when further enquiry would require a capability not available here (closed-loop counterfactual replay, control_snapshots.json, or a bounded projected-model probe longer than the permitted <=0.01 s effective horizon) and that gap is declared explicitly rather than filled by inference.

Stop when any threshold observation (0.01 m position limit, 0.02 m/s speed limit, 0.05 s window, 0.01 s control period, 10 ms deadline) is reported as a fact with its handle and not as a proven cause of the observed excursion.
